shop.name: Lahore Auto Pro
shop.description: We handle everything from routine maintenance to major repairs — engine work, brakes, AC service, body repairs, and complete diagnostics. Our experienced mechanics use modern equipment and genuine parts to get every job done right. No shortcuts, no guesswork — just honest, reliable service that keeps your car running at its best.
shop.mission: To provide every customer with honest, high-quality auto repair service — using modern diagnostic tools, genuine parts, and skilled mechanics who treat every vehicle like their own.
shop.vision: To be Lahore's most recommended auto workshop — known for fair pricing, dependable workmanship, and a team that puts customer trust above everything else.

hero.headline: Lahore's Trusted Auto Repair Experts
hero.subheadline: From routine maintenance to major overhauls — professional diagnostics, certified mechanics, and quality parts that keep your vehicle running smoothly.

services.name: Engine Rebuild
services.description: Complete engine overhaul and rebuilding for petrol, diesel, and CNG vehicles. We strip, inspect, and machine every component to factory tolerance so your engine runs smoother and lasts longer.

services.name: Body Work
services.description: Dent removal, panel beating, welding, and full body alignment. Whether it's a minor fender bender or serious collision damage, our panel beaters bring your car's frame back to true.

services.name: Restoration
services.description: Full classic and vintage car restoration — from bare-metal stripping to showroom finish. We source original parts and preserve the character of your vehicle.

services.name: Custom Paint
services.description: Spray painting, metallic, and two-tone finishes using quality imported paints. Our spray booth delivers a flawless, durable finish with rust protection baked in.

whyChooseUs.title: Certified Mechanics
whyChooseUs.description: A team trained and certified in modern engine and body repair techniques, with years of hands-on experience on both classic and modern vehicles.

whyChooseUs.title: Genuine Parts
whyChooseUs.description: We only fit original and high-grade parts. No cheap imitations — because the quality of a repair depends on the quality of the parts we install.

whyChooseUs.title: Free Inspection
whyChooseUs.description: Bring your car in for a thorough inspection and an honest assessment. If a repair isn't worth the cost, we'll tell you straight.

whyChooseUs.title: 12-Month Warranty
whyChooseUs.description: Every restoration and major repair is backed by a workmanship warranty of up to 12 months. If anything goes wrong, we make it right at no extra cost.

workProcess.title: Diagnose
workProcess.description: We inspect your vehicle inside and out, run a full mechanical check, and identify every issue so you know exactly what needs to be done.

workProcess.title: Plan
workProcess.description: You get a clear, itemised plan with an honest quote. We agree on scope, timeline, and budget before any work begins — no surprises.

workProcess.title: Restore
workProcess.description: Our mechanics and body specialists carry out the work with precision — engine, body, and paint — keeping you updated at every stage.

workProcess.title: Deliver
workProcess.description: We road-test every vehicle and run a final quality check before handing back the keys, along with a record of the work done.

faqs.question: How long does a full car restoration take?
faqs.answer: A complete restoration typically takes 3 to 6 weeks, depending on the vehicle's condition and the scope of work. Minor body and paint jobs are usually finished in 5 to 10 days. You'll get a clear timeline after the initial free inspection.

faqs.question: Do you work on all car brands and models?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle Japanese, European, Korean, and locally assembled vehicles — from classic cars like the 1970s Corollas and Beetles to modern sedans and SUVs.

faqs.question: What type of paint do you use, and how long does it last?
faqs.answer: We use quality imported two-pack and metallic paints with proper surface preparation and rust protection. A professionally done job holds its shine and finish for years with normal care.

faqs.question: Is the 12-month warranty really included in the price?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every restoration and major repair includes a workmanship warranty of up to 12 months at no extra charge. It covers defects in our workmanship, not normal wear and tear.

faqs.question: Do I need to book an appointment, or can I just drop in?
faqs.answer: You're welcome to drop in anytime — we're open 24 hours. For major restorations we recommend booking a free inspection slot so our team can give the car their full attention.

faqs.question: Can you restore a car that has been sitting for many years?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Vehicles that have been parked for years are some of our favourite projects. We bring them back mechanically and cosmetically — engine, brakes, wiring, and paint.
